confidence_notes: Food, coffee and beer anchors are the best supported: they draw on the July 2026 Numbeo Arequipa snapshot (crowd-sourced, few contributors; the October 2026 snapshot was a cross-check only) and Arequipa or Peru-wide travel-cost guides from search, with sol figures converted at approximate market rates. The two-person mid-range meal rests on one reported figure and is less certain. No Arequipa restaurant wine-glass price was found, so wine_glass uses the local beer relationship (about twice a draft beer), checked against Peru-wide glass ranges. Cocktail uses a Peru-wide pisco sour range and Arequipa bar listings, cross-checked against the beer relationship (about 2.5 to 3 times a draft beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation searches were run and no live listings or booking pages were inspected. FX is the latest RBA figure confirmed by search (18 November 2026); no 19 November figure was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: No foreign comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are Arequipa-specific, with Peru-wide guide ranges as cross-checks. Accommodation is a holistic placement of Arequipa as a major Peruvian tourist city that the guides rate cheaper than Lima and Cusco.
